scientific_integrity.earlier_supporting_literature: Javaid et al. arXiv:1607.04071v1 (first posted 2016-07-14); their scalar corona formula is explicitly treated as known, not as a new result
scientific_integrity.verification: Full combinatorial proof and bounded exhaustive independent computation on small instances; no certification asserted.

scientific_limitations: Ordinary zero forcing only; all attached private cliques must have order at least two.
The case of order-one private cliques is genuinely excluded by a counterexample.
Computing the complete polynomial on arbitrary bases remains dependent on the base zero-forcing polynomial.
Only a self-review was performed; independent audit is not claimed.
Related but unindexed or implicit preexisting counting identities cannot be excluded.
title: Zero-forcing enumerators of clique-decorated graphs
